annotations.text:
1. Event Workspace — home
The EVENT is the persistent central object (header card), not chat or a list. "Still deciding" shows ONE open item at a time, answered inline (accordion), then it becomes a chip in "What I know" — no fixed sequence, no form rows.

2. Workspace — providers section loading
Event header + resolved details stay visible and stable; only the Providers section shows loading. Nothing takes over the screen.

3. Workspace — providers populated
Event card condenses to a one-line summary (still present, still the anchor). Providers become the focus: horizontal carousel (all visible by swiping) + a Top Match card, not a single full-bleed card or a stacked list.

4. Provider detail — drill-down
Header reads as a breadcrumb: Emma's Birthday Party › Sandi's Moonwalks. This is 'opening part of the event,' not leaving the app or an overlay sheet. Same FACT/INFERRED + dimension-bar content as the other concepts.

5. M10 loading
Same breadcrumb drill-down, content swapped to loading.

6. M10 questions + M11 simulated answers
Dashed amber SIMULATED cards + no-contact banner, consistent with Concepts 1 & 2. "Back to Emma's Birthday Party" returns to the object, not to a generic list or chat.

7. Error state
Inline in the Providers section only — the event header and everything already known stay fully visible and intact.
